body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2007') -- <Visual News> Motorola presented ''AUDEX'' jacket with a digital audio player and speaker built in during CES 2007. Via Bluetooth, users can let the device play music being played on their mobile phones.
< AVING Special Report Team for 2007 International CES: Editor & Publisher, Brain Park, Min Choi, Kevin Choi, Joshua Shim, Rose Kim, Niki Hwang, Alliyah Seo, Jun Lee, Daniel Sirh >
